'''Town Warehouse''' is a location inside the [[Town]]. Is locked until complete the [[quest]] "[[Docked and Found]]" and you talk to [[Jack]] in front of the Warehouse.

== Town orders ==
Here, the [[Keeper]] can accept town orders during {{Icon|Pride|size=25}} and complete them by delivering Supply Crates.
